comparisons.reason: Both read OC_comments and return an any-comment binary with the same null and empty-list rules, but the constructs differ. Item 0 counts any concrete real-world example (specific case, event, person, statistic-bearing situation, or personal real-life experience) used to support the comment's point. Item 1 requires an analogy or comparison to a specific, named real-world case, and it must be used against the OP. Item 0 is broader: it includes unnamed personal anecdotes and non-analogical evidence. Item 1 is narrower: it needs an analogical use and a named referent, and it requires an argument against the OP.
